title: bazis-screen/1: spec/screens/<id>.yaml
description: A screen of the frontend: one primitive (list, card, form, dashboard, board or calendar) over an entity of spec/product.yaml (a dashboard has none: each of its parts names its own), its actions and the states it renders. The screen marks its elements with `data-bz` attributes: screen:<id>, state:<loading|empty|loaded|error|forbidden|not_found|invalid|done>, list:<entity>, row:<id>, cell:<field>, field:<field>, error:<field>, action:<id>, transit:<id>, status:<id>, nav:<screen>; select:<id> and bulk:<id> (the bulk actions of a list), tab:<id> (the tabs of a card), tile:<id>, chart:<id> and recent:<id> (a dashboard), column:<status> and move:<status> (a board), day:<date> (a calendar). The required states of a primitive: list loading, empty, error, forbidden; card loading, error, forbidden, not_found; form loading, error, forbidden, invalid (and done, the result of a form of a custom action with `result`); dashboard loading, error; board and calendar loading, empty, error, forbidden.

id.description: The id of the screen, also the name of its file.

title.description: The title of the screen, also the label of its link and of the way back to it; a generated card does not show it, the label of its item heads it.

description.description: The subtitle of the screen, under its title.

route.description: The route of the screen in the frontend; `:id` is the id of the item.

entity.description: The id of an entity of spec/product.yaml; none on a dashboard.

roles.description: The roles that use the screen in the scenarios; the backend decides the access (and the navigation shows the link of the screen to the users it allows: `NavItem.requires`).

custom.description: The screen is written by hand, not generated from its spec: `true`, the export `<Id in PascalCase>Screen` of frontend/src/screens/<id>/index.tsx; or the export of another module of frontend/src/screens (several screens in one file). Its route, its link and its texts are generated all the same; S028 when the file or the export is missing.

module.description: The module, `@/screens/<path>` (frontend/src/screens/<path>.tsx or <path>/index.tsx); never one of src/screens/generated/, which `bazis_front screens` writes.

export.description: The component of the screen that it exports.

extend.description: The generated screen takes the extension `export const extension` of frontend/src/screens/<id>/extend.tsx: what its spec cannot say, in the slots of the screen and the props of its component (S031 when the file or its export is missing, or the screen is `custom`: a custom screen extends itself in its own code).

nav.description: false: the screen has no link in the navigation that is generated without `navigation` of spec/product.yaml (a screen of an item or a form never has one).

filters.description: Fields that the contract can filter by, read from `route_filter_fields/` of the route set, which its `actions` keep (S040).

open.description: The card screen that a row opens.

empty.description: The text of the list without items (`emptyMessage`); that of the component by default.

filter.description: The filter of the screen itself, a report of some of the items: each field (that the contract can filter by) equal to its value, combined (AND) with the filters and the search of the user (`ResourceList` `filter`).

map.description: A map of the items of the list beside it (`ResourceMap` of the component map): a marker for each item with a point in `field` (a field of the entity with `type: point`, S016), which opens the card of `open`.

highlight.description: The rows highlighted with a tone of the theme: those whose boolean field is true (`ResourceList` `rowTone`), with the label that says it in words (a key of the dictionaries of the frontend or a text: `rowToneLabel`, the description of the row), required (S014): never the color alone.

row_actions.description: The custom actions of the screen (`actions`, `primitive: custom`, of an item) run on each row, a button `action:<id>` in it; the other actions of a list are those of its toolbar.

bulk.description: The actions on the rows that the user selects (`select:<id>`), each item in turn: a transition of the workflow of the entity (one without a payload, S025), the deletion, or a custom action of an item (one whose body needs nothing, S032); the button `bulk:<id>`, shown while rows are selected, asks to confirm (`action:confirm-bulk`).

transit.description: The id of a transition of the workflow.

action.description: A custom action of an item, run with an empty body: its name in its path, as `custom_actions` of the contract has it.

when.description: The section is shown only while the item is in one of these statuses of the workflow of the entity (S059); always without it. Its fields stay in the edit of the card.

edit.description: The item is edited on the card, by the update form of its runtime schema.

transitions.description: The transits of the item (its workflow).

history.description: The status history of the item (its workflow).

related.description: The items of other entities that reference the item of the card (`RelatedList` of resource-card): a list of the related entity filtered by its to-one relationship to the item, and "add here", the create form of the related entity with that relationship fixed to the item (its action `add.id`).

entity.description: The id of the related entity of spec/product.yaml.

relation.description: The to-one relationship (`relation`) of the related entity to the entity of the card, which the contract can filter by.

open.description: The card screen of the related entity that a row opens.

add.description: "Add here": the action `id` of the card opens the create form of the related entity, its `fields` (all the writable fields but the relationship when omitted), with the relationship to the item fixed.

when.description: When the action is shown: `changeable`, while the user may change the item of the card (the default), or `always` (the backend decides at the submit).

tabs.description: The card in tabs (`tab:<id>`): each section, each related section and the history in exactly one tab (S024); without `tabs` they are one below the other. The transits stay above the tabs.

sections.description: The ids of sections of the card.

related.description: The ids of related sections of the card.

history.description: The status history of the item (`history` of the card).

form.description: A form as a page: the create or the update form of the entity (`mode`), or the form of a custom action of the route set of the entity (`action`), whose fields are the properties of its JSON body and need no runtime schema (a guest who reads nothing of the entity sends it on a public screen).

fields.description: The fields of the form; all the writable fields of its runtime schema when omitted.

then.description: The screen shown after a submit.

action.description: The custom action of the route set of the entity (a POST, not of an item): its name in its path (`apply` of `/repairs/repair/apply/`), as `custom_actions` of the contract has it (S032).

fields.description: The properties of its JSON body that the form asks for, in this order; each that the body requires among them (S032). A property named as a to-one relationship of the entity in the contract is the picker of its related item (an array named as a to-many one, of its items), its title that of the field of the entity in the contract.

submit.description: The label of its submit button: `Send` by default.

result.description: What the page shows once the action is done (`state:done`), in place of the form: `message`, whose `{name}` are the properties of the JSON answer of the action in the contract, or `{filename}` of an action that answers a file, which the form saves first (S053), under `title` (the title of the screen by default), with the link of `then` and `action:again`, which shows the form again, empty.

then.description: The screen without an item that the link of the result opens (`nav:<screen>`); without `result`, the screen shown once the action is done.

dashboard.description: An overview of the entities: tiles that count the items of a filter or show an aggregate of a field of them, charts of the items by status or by date, the last items of an entity and the create forms of entities. A tile and a chart are the aggregates of a list of the API (`meta=aggregates` of the core, bazis 2.17): over the items that the user may view with the filter, of the fields that the route set filters by.

tiles.description: The count of the items of an entity with the `filter` of a list, or the aggregate `value` of a field of them (`tile:<id>`, the number in `data-value`); a click opens the list `open`.

value.description: The aggregate of a field of the items that the tile shows instead of their number: its sum or average (a number field), its minimum or maximum (a number or a date field), `{sum: amount}` (S049), shown as the `display` of the field; a field that the route set filters by (S050).

icon.description: The icon of the tile, a lucide icon (D013); that of its entity (`icons` of theme.yaml) by default.

open.description: The list screen of the entity that the tile opens.

charts.description: The items of an entity by its status (`status` of an entity with a workflow: a count for each status) or by a date or a date-time field (a count for each `bucket`, the `last` ones up to the current one), or the sum or the average `value` of a field of them, `chart:<id>`.

value.description: The aggregate of a number field of the items that the chart shows instead of their number: its sum or average, `{sum: amount}` (S049); a field that the route set filters by (S050).

recent.description: The last items of an entity by `sort` (`recent:<id>`, its rows `row:<id>` with their cells `cell:<column>`), each opening the card `open`.

open.description: The card screen of the entity that a row opens.

then.description: The screen shown after the form.

label.description: The label of its button, also the title of its form.

board.description: The items of the entity in a column for each status of its workflow (`column:<status>`, a list filtered by the status, its items `row:<id>` with their cells `cell:<field>`); with `move`, an item moves to the column of a status that a transit of the item leads to (its menu `action:move`, `move:<status>`).

by.description: The status of the workflow (bazis-statusy), the only field of the columns.

columns.description: The statuses of the columns, in their order; all those of the workflow by default.

card.description: An item in its column: its title, its fields, and a badge while its boolean field `badge` is true.

filters.description: Fields that the contract can filter by, read from `route_filter_fields/` of the route set, which its `actions` keep (S040).

move.description: The items move between the columns by the transits that the backend allows them.

open.description: The card screen that an item opens.

empty.description: The text of the board without items (`emptyMessage`); that of the component by default.

calendar.description: The items of the entity on the days of a date or a date-time field, a month or a week at a time (`day:<YYYY-MM-DD>`, the number of its items in `data-count`, its items `row:<id>` with their cells `cell:<field>`).

field.description: The date or date-time field of the day of an item.

end.description: The date or date-time field of the last day of an item that spans days.

label.description: The fields that an item shows; the label of the entity by default.

tone.description: The items whose boolean field is true, in a tone of the theme.

filters.description: Fields that the contract can filter by, read from `route_filter_fields/` of the route set, which its `actions` keep (S040): the items of the user's choice, a relation (the schedule of one doctor) or a choice. The add starts its form with the related item or the choice of a filter of one of its fields.

open.description: The card screen that an item opens.

add.description: The action `id` opens the create form of the entity, its `fields` (all the writable fields when omitted), `field` filled with the day selected (today by default).

time.description: The time of the date-time `field` on the selected day, `HH:MM` in the time zone of the browser (the start of the opening hours); the start of the day (00:00) by default (S042).

duration.description: The minutes from the date-time `field` to the date-time `end` of a new item, which its form starts with (S042, S043).

requires.description: What the backend must let the user do for the part to be shown: view the items of its entity (the default) or add one (`can: add`: the tile "New" only for those who may add), as `requires` of a link of the navigation (S030).

icon.description: The name of a lucide icon (lucide.dev), in kebab-case (D013).

sort.description: The order of the items by default: fields that the contract can sort by, `-` for descending, by the first field, then by the next one for the items equal by it; each field once (S039). The user sorts a list by the headers of its columns.

filter.description: Each field (that the contract can filter by) equal to its value.

filters.description: The items that the pickers of the relationships of a form offer, by field (by property of the body of a custom action) among those it asks for: the items of the related resource that match the filter (S061), each of its keys a field or a path through the relationships (`roles__slug: master`) that the contract can filter by.

text.description: A text of the interface: a key of the dictionaries of the frontend (lowercase words joined by dots, no space: `tiles.on_hand`), a text in the default language of the product (`language` of spec/product.yaml), or the text in each language of the product (`{en: Loans, ru: Выдачи}`); `check` warns about a text that is not in every language of `languages` (S027).

label.description: A key of the dictionaries of the frontend, or a text: never the color alone.

labels.description: The labels of properties of the body of a custom action by their names, in the languages of the product: before the title of the field of the entity named so (in the contract or the runtime schema) and the title of the property in the body (in the language of the backend).

values.description: The values that the fields of a custom action start with (its dialog or its form), by their properties among its `fields` (S060): a text, a number or a boolean of the type of the property, or for a date (`format: date` or `date-time`) a day of the browser when it opens: `today`, `today+<n>`, `today-<n>`, `month_start`, `month_end`, followed by ` HH:MM` for a date-time (`today 09:00`). Over the default of the property in the body.

action.description: `form`: a form of the entity (create on a list or a card, update on a card); `destroy`: the deletion of the item of a card; `custom`: a custom action of the route set of the entity (`custom_actions` of its resource in the contract, a POST), of the item of a card, of each row of a list (an action of an item) or of the toolbar of a list (an action of the route set).

fields.description: The fields of a form; of a custom action, the properties of its JSON body that its dialog asks for (none: an empty body), as the form of an action (`form.action`) shows them.

action.description: The custom action: its name in its path (`escalate` of `/tasks/task/{id}/escalate/`), as `custom_actions` of the contract has it.

confirm.description: Whether a custom action without `fields` is confirmed in a dialog first (`action:confirm-<id>`).

message.description: What the toast says once a custom action is done: `Done` by default.

then.description: The screen shown after the action.

label.description: The label of its button, also the title of its form.

title.description: The title of the confirmation of a deletion, a question (`Delete the book?`): `Delete this item?` by default; the title of the dialog of a custom action: its label by default.

description.description: The description of its form, of the confirmation of a deletion, or of the dialog of a custom action.
